items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: because what's his name was the manager then, the other trombone player

ctx.x: Louie was all right, and then, like when we were at the hotel here, the Ambassador -- the Hotel Ambassador here, they want for me to work for so and so and I want so and so and so. I said no. And every payday, Louie had to go to the cashier and give me my money, because what's his name was the manager then, the other trombone player ...
